title: Existing finite-ring geometric Verdier duality
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $k$ be an algebraically closed field such that the additive exponent of $A$ is invertible in $k$, and let $a:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated of finite type. Work in the derived category of ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Let $D_X=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,Ra^!A)$ and let $\delta$ be its canonical evaluation transpose [lem-weil-duality-pairing]. If $K$ is bounded constructible [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] and has finite Tor amplitude [def-kun-tor-amplitude], then $\delta_K$ is an isomorphism and $D_XK$ is again bounded constructible with finite Tor amplitude. Here separated finite type is as in [def-weil-proper-morphism], without requiring properness.

proof.text: Use the existing source proofs attached below. Preservation is constructibleFiniteTor_verdierDual: choose a finite dimension bound and apply constructibleFiniteTor_and_torAmplitudeIn_verdierDual_of_perfectField, since an algebraically closed field is perfect. Biduality is isIso_verdierDualDoubleDual_app, proved by isIso_verdierDualDoubleDual_app_of_isAlgClosed in GeometricBidualityInduction. The latter performs simultaneous strong induction on the dimension over algebraically closed fields: nonclosed stalks of the cone vanish by geometric generic fibers of smaller dimension; the remaining finite-support cone has zero proper pushforward by point biduality, hence is zero by its finite-support cohomology calculation; dense compactification and restriction then give the general case. These are already compiled Lean proofs, not new unproved assertions or a second copy of the item theorem. No new Lean module or hole is introduced.
